_comment: What the character production pipeline can make, for the planning skills (scripts/planning/video_plan.py ready): a plan that needs a capability that is false here is locked with that dependency listed, never changed to another format. Each key is one capability of the shared production bridge (scripts/character/bridge.py). true means the scripts, checks and skills exist; real media, approved characters, narrators and screens are still each video's own inputs.

_what.bridge.B: a silent generated action: hands only, pet only or an approved mascot (segment B); never the app
_what.bridge.C: supplied media: a clip or a still from the plan's assets, checksum, range and source approval at gate B (segment C); a filmed phone goes through the insertion gates of its mode
_what.bridge.narration: a narrator independent of the face: a character's approved performance, a supplied voice, or an original synthetic narrator's approved takes (audio_from)
_what.bridge.motion_design: the third source of a full-screen app beat (R or P), after a real recording and a real still (founder, 2026-10-19): the app's real screens rebuilt in code from PRODUCT-SCREENS.md and the app's own code and in-app text, animated (taps, scrolls, the result appearing) and rendered locally at 1080x1920 (motion_design.py, motion_render.mjs), its gates checked and the render approved at gate B (review.py motion). Free, no video model, no invented interface or text. A real recording is preferred: the plan says why it picks motion design (demo_source_reason)
_what.bridge.composition: split-screen and picture-in-picture panels (segment M), sequential stitch, timed overlays, the source credit and the day counter, checked at gate C
_what.bridge.live: a real input clip paired with its app recording, the measured offset checked in sequence or in panels
_what.bridge.reaction: a silent reaction (segment X): the handle's approved character, no voice and no lip sync, under the timed hook overlay, from a real reference reaction (reaction_refs). Every reaction with a reference is a motion copy (bridge.motion_copy, founder 2026-10-19). The written route (generation_input written) performs the written expression beats with no clip; it is only a fallback the user names after a failed motion take (written_reason), with identity, hands, silence, performance and duration approved at gate B
_what.bridge.motion_copy: true since 2026-10-14 (named bridge.face_replace before 2026-10-19; scripts still read that name): the founder ran the paid tests in a user workspace and approved them. Motion copy is the one default of every reaction with a reference: the motion route (models.json motion_copy.default_route), Kling 3.0 Pro Motion Control on Supagen (template ugc-character-face-kling-motion), the character's approved first frame (a keyframe made from the hero and the clip's first frame, approved at gate A) moved by the original clip, padded to 3.0 s and trimmed back at assembly. A visible face is not required. The backup is the replace route (Wan 2.2 Animate replace on Supagen, the original clip and one face picture), named in the shot only after a failed motion take: its test got the face shape, the clothes and the room wrong. animate (Wan 2.2 Animate move) timed out on Supagen and stays a fallback; guided (MiniMax H3 reference-to-video) is untested; edit (Wan 2.7 Edit Video) kept the reference person's face and is retired. Every take is measured by the identity gate (identity.py, OpenCV YuNet and SFace) over the frames of the clip's range that show a face, and review.py refuses a motion-copy approval on a FAIL. A motion-copy X neither continues nor is continued (continuity.py). Set this to false to stop every live motion-copy run (REQUEST_ONLY=1 still shows the request)
_what.bridge.continuity: clip-to-clip continuity: a shot continues from the clip before it (shot continuity.from), the previous clip's approved last frame taken with its checksum (continuity.py), checked at validate, refs, generate and gate B, cut without a repeated frame at assembly. T, B and X by the written route only
_what.bridge.continuity.input_verified: false until a paid continuing run is measured. No model of the pipeline has a first-frame input: the frame goes to the H3 models as the first reference image (models.json known_model_limits.<model>.continuity, UNVERIFIED), and the motion-copy models cannot continue. Live runs are not blocked: the request has the shape of every referenced run, and generate.sh prints the UNVERIFIED status in the cost step
